import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_26/test_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_26/test_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_26/test_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_26/test_3.csv"
]

# Columns in source files (all have the same schema)
source_columns = ['datetime', 'station', 'obs_type', 'obs_value', 'TMAX_F', 'month', 'country_code']

# Target schema and column order
target_columns = ['month', 'station', 'datetime', 'obs_type', 'obs_value', 'TMAX_F', 'country_code']

# Function to convert 'datetime' column from string date to integer YYYYMMDD format
def convert_datetime_to_int(df, col='datetime'):
    # Convert to datetime type
    dt = pd.to_datetime(df[col], errors='coerce')
    # Format as YYYYMMDD integer
    df[col] = dt.dt.strftime('%Y%m%d').astype('Int64')
    return df

# Function to convert 'station' to integer by extracting digits only
def convert_station_to_int(df, col='station'):
    # Extract digits from station string and convert to int
    df[col] = df[col].astype(str).str.extract('(\d+)').astype('Int64')
    return df

# Function to convert 'obs_type' to integer by mapping unique values
def convert_obs_type_to_int(df, col='obs_type'):
    # Create mapping from unique obs_type strings to integers
    unique_types = df[col].unique()
    mapping = {k: i for i, k in enumerate(sorted(unique_types), start=1)}
    df[col] = df[col].map(mapping).astype('Int64')
    return df

# Function to convert 'country_code' to integer by mapping unique values
def convert_country_code_to_int(df, col='country_code'):
    unique_codes = df[col].unique()
    mapping = {k: i for i, k in enumerate(sorted(unique_codes), start=1)}
    df[col] = df[col].map(mapping).astype('Int64')
    return df

# Load all source dataframes
dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# Concatenate all source dataframes (UNION operation)
df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Convert columns to target types and order

# Convert datetime to integer YYYYMMDD
df_all = convert_datetime_to_int(df_all, 'datetime')

# Convert station to integer by extracting digits
df_all = convert_station_to_int(df_all, 'station')

# Convert obs_type to integer mapping
df_all = convert_obs_type_to_int(df_all, 'obs_type')

# obs_value is integer in target, source has float, convert by rounding and to int
df_all['obs_value'] = df_all['obs_value'].round().astype('Int64')

# TMAX_F is integer in target, source has float, convert by rounding and to int
df_all['TMAX_F'] = df_all['TMAX_F'].round().astype('Int64')

# month is integer, ensure type
df_all['month'] = df_all['month'].astype('Int64')

# Convert country_code to integer mapping
df_all = convert_country_code_to_int(df_all, 'country_code')

# Reorder columns to target schema
df_all = df_all[target_columns]

# Save to target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_26/target_multisource.csv"
df_all.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
